notes.cross-package-name-collision: KNOWN FAILURE, a minimal repro of the last thing blocking real WASI p3. Two packages both declare `interface types`; resolving a `use` into the other package hits its unqualified `use types.{duration}`, which the resolver answers from the scope stack rather than from the package that owns the interface, so it reports a false cycle. Fixing it means tracking the current package across file-level `package …;` declarations, which the resolver only does for nested `package x { … }` blocks.
